title: Cholecystostomy Tube Exchange/Removal
summary: Existing tube maintenance and assessment for safe removal; routine mature-tract exchange is distinct from new placement.

Tolerated capping trial if used by the treating team; confirm no ongoing need for drainage before removal.

items: Vital signs per routine.
Monitor the access site for bleeding or bile leakage.

blocks.title: Access care
items: After exchange: secure the tube, maintain prescribed drainage, and continue the established flush plan.
After removal: apply a dressing and provide wound-care instructions.

blocks.title: Discharge
items: Discharge when clinically appropriate with medication reconciliation.

blocks.title: Follow up
items: If the tube remains: arrange the next drain check/exchange per IR plan.
Calculous cholecystitis: surgery manages and tube comes out with cholecystectomy.
